newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Aussie Home writes A$1 mln business loans/day.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Aussie Home writes A$1 mln business loans/day.

text.p: Mortgage originator Aussie Home Loans said on Monday it was writing A$1 million in small business loans at the end of its first month in this lending sector.

The company, which says it is the fifth largest housing finance lender in Australia, on February 10 announced a 7.49 percent "no-frills" small business loan which was secured by the borrower's first mortgage.
"It has built up to A$1 million a day in small business loans," managing director John Symond told Reuters.
He said business loans in March would total about A$30 million and this should eventually rise to up to A$50 million a month.

The move into the business sector, which was welcomed by the government of Prime Minister John Howard as a much-needed competitive boost to the sector, was confronted nine days later by the Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd which said it would offer a 7.9 percent business loan backed with A$1 billion of funding for the first three months.

Symond said Aussie Home Loans, which has an exclusive securitisation deal with the PUMA division of Macquarie Bank Ltd, wrote A$301 million of new home loans in February which was the second highest on record.
He said the privately-held company, which had 1995/96 net profits of about A$4.5 million, had exceeded this in the first nine months of the current year.
